svg.title: PangoLock - zero-knowledge folder vault for macOS
svg.desc: Featured project PangoLock (Swift, SwiftUI, macOS 13+, MIT, v0.2.1, pre-1.0). A holographic vault cube rotates inside an orbiting ring of ciphertext while a packet runs the lock sequence: password, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 210,000 iterations, master key checked by a zero-knowledge verifier, HKDF-SHA256 per-item key, AES-256-GCM, atomic write of a uuid.plock file, decrypt and compare, original removed, locked. 87 XCTest tests, CI on macOS, written threat model, Keychain and Touch ID, recovery key, encrypted sharing.

g.text: a separate key for every item
